# Model card — `encounter-priority` (EXPERIMENTAL)

**Purpose.** Rank screened encounters for analyst review when covariance is unavailable. Outputs are **priority scores in [0, 1], not probabilities of collision**. They are stored separately from all physical metrics, labelled "experimental" in the UI and reports, and the screening pipeline works identically without the model.

**Intended users.** Researchers evaluating ASTRAL's ML pipeline. **Not for operational use.**

## Training data

* Origin: **synthetic**, generated by `astral.ml.dataset.generate` (seed 20261011, 3,000 event series, 8,859 rows).
* Geometry: miss distance log-uniform over 50 m–50 km; relative speed 0.2–15.5 km/s; altitude 300–1,500 km.
* **Assumed** uncertainty-growth model (not fitted to any real data): σ_T = 0.05 + 0.35·age + 0.02·hours-to-TCA km; σ_R = σ_N = σ_T/6.
* Label: ASTRAL 2D Pc (HBR 20 m) ≥ 1e-3 → priority. Prevalence 4.1 %. The threshold was chosen to create a rare-event problem, **not** as an operational criterion.
* Training data SHA-256 is stored with each model (`ml_models.training_data_sha256`).

## Features (`features/1`)

log10 miss, relative speed, approach angle, radial fraction of miss, altitude, max data age, hours to TCA. Pc and covariance-derived values are excluded: they would leak the label, and the model's purpose is the no-covariance case.

## Method

Candidates: rule baseline (score = −log10 miss); logistic regression (C ∈ {0.1, 1, 10}, balanced); histogram gradient boosting (depth ∈ {3, 6}, lr ∈ {0.05, 0.1}). Splits are **group-disjoint** (all updates of an event in one split) and **temporal** (latest 20 % of events = test; latest 20 % of the remainder = validation). Leakage guards raise errors. Selection uses validation average precision. The chosen model is refit on train+validation and evaluated once on test.

## Results (held-out test, 1,747 events, 80 positive; model `encounter-priority:1`)

| Model | Average precision | Precision @0.5 | Recall @0.5 | FN rate | Brier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| hist_gbm (depth 6, lr 0.05) — selected | 0.966 | 0.944 | 0.850 | 0.150 | 0.0075 |
| logistic (C 0.1) — validation only | 0.769 (val) | — | — | — | — |
| rule: miss distance | 0.189 | — | — | — | — |

Confusion matrix @0.5: TN 1,663 · FP 4 · FN 12 · TP 68. Per-regime AP and calibration curves are shown in the ML laboratory view.

**Interpretation.** The model learns the *assumed* covariance-growth model used to make the labels. Its advantage over the miss-only rule shows that data age and time-to-TCA matter **under that assumption**. It says nothing about real operations. Accuracy is not reported (a never-flag model would exceed 95 %).

## Safeguards

Out-of-distribution flags (features outside training ranges) are attached to each score. Schema-version and artefact-hash checks run on load; any loading or scoring failure disables ML without affecting screening. Models are always "experimental"; *activation* only makes scores visible.

## To use real labels

Provide authorised labelled data matching `features/1` (plus event group id and timestamp). Replace `generate()` with a loader that sets `origin="authorised_labelled"`, retrain via `train()`, and review the metrics before activation. Real-world validity still requires independent evaluation.
